# Operating Layer

Operating Layer is inventory, order, purchasing and warehouse operations software for growing product businesses.

It connects multi-location inventory, customer orders, purchasing, suppliers, warehouse execution, cycle counts, wave picking, replenishment, reporting and human-reviewed automation in one auditable workspace.

## Core capabilities

- Multi-location inventory management with on-hand, reserved, available and incoming stock.
- Immutable stock movement history for adjustments, transfers, receipts, fulfilment, returns and stocktakes.
- Order management with stock reservation, oversell prevention, fulfilment priority, required-by dates, partial fulfilment and returns.
- Purchase-order management with suppliers, expected delivery dates, partial receiving, cancellation and discrepancy handling.
- Warehouse workflows for manual barcode entry, hardware scanners and mobile-camera scanning.
- Wave picking for 2–10 same-location orders with deterministic allocation back to exact order lines.
- Cycle counting with stale-snapshot and reservation protection.
- Deterministic inventory replenishment suggestions using stock, incoming supply, demand and supplier lead time.
- Operations and inventory reports over canonical stock, order and purchasing records.
- Reviewed document extraction and matching workflows. AI may propose information for human review but does not autonomously mutate canonical inventory, fulfil orders or commit purchase orders.
- Role-based access for owners, administrators, managers, inventory, fulfilment and viewer users.
- Tenant-isolated operational storage and audited mutation paths.

## Audience

Operating Layer is aimed at SMEs and growing product businesses that have outgrown disconnected spreadsheets and manual inventory/order reconciliation but do not want an unnecessarily heavy enterprise ERP implementation.

## Product principle

The system between order and outcome: keep inventory, orders, purchasing and warehouse work in one controlled operating loop, automate repetitive evidence work and keep important business decisions explicit, reviewable and attributable to people.
